cases.title: UNKNOWN is treated as NON_IDEMPOTENT everywhere
cases.when: An UNKNOWN tool is dispatched, the ADMITTED message is dropped, and the tool issues a request that times out
then: A ledger row exists and admission uses the fencing token
The Gateway never re-dispatches; it queries the ledger
The invocation ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with broker evidence

cases.title: Every source without a declaration resolves to UNKNOWN
cases.when: Tools arrive from an SDK without effect, a v1 package, a legacy manifest, an OPENAPI import of GET and POST operations, and an MCP_PROXY snapshot with readOnlyHint=true
then: Every resolved effect class is UNKNOWN until review sets it
The HTTP method and upstream hints are never used to infer it

cases.title: MCP hints are derived from the effect class
cases.when: tools/list is served for one tool of each class
then: readOnlyHint is true only for READ_ONLY
idempotentHint is true only for READ_ONLY and IDEMPOTENT

cases.title: Weakening the effect class is a security delta
cases.when: A new version changes UNKNOWN to IDEMPOTENT, then NON_IDEMPOTENT to READ_ONLY, then READ_ONLY to NON_IDEMPOTENT
then: The first two need security re-approval
The third is shown as narrowing and needs no re-approval

cases.title: Retries follow the class
cases.when: Each class gets an upstream 503 then 200 on a route with a retry policy
then: READ_ONLY and IDEMPOTENT: retried per policy
NON_IDEMPOTENT and UNKNOWN: no retry, no redirect followed
